description: Transcribe one audio input verbatim through the MiniMax Mavis gateway. An empty transcription is reported as a failure rather than an empty success.

input.description: Audio to transcribe: a public HTTP(S) audio URL or a kkstudio:/resources/<blobId> audio resource of the current session.

prompt.description: Optional transcription hint, for example keeping product names or proper nouns verbatim.

language.description: Optional expected language code. It becomes part of the transcription hint and is never sent as a gateway field on its own.
